_comment: Copy this to ~/.config/tgclaude/mcp-config.json and edit. Or set TGCLAUDE_MCP_CONFIG to point at your own path. The bot resolves in this order: env var → ~/.config/tgclaude/mcp-config.json → this example as last-resort fallback.
_memory_hint: Attach whatever MCP servers you want the bot's Claude sessions to see - a long-term memory backend is the classic choice. To keep a memory server's read-only tools available in locked mode, list them in TGCLAUDE_LOCKED_MCP_TOOLS (comma-separated, e.g. mcp__mymemory__search). Do NOT commit real keys to this file.
